Title: Initial DOM launch
Steps: 1. Open build. 2. Wait for initialization. 3. Observe title/menu.
Expected Result: Title and Play menu are visible.

Title: 200 deterministic puzzle checks
Steps: 1. Run lightSudokuSelfTest(50). 2. Review problems.

Title: Start Diagonal
Steps: 1. Start DIAGONAL. 2. Count cells/givens/pad. 3. Read hints.

Title: Start Irregular
Steps: 1. Start IRREGULAR. 2. Count cells/givens/pad. 3. Read hints.

Title: Start Classic
Steps: 1. Start CLASSIC. 2. Count cells/givens/pad. 3. Read hints.

Title: Start Mini
Steps: 1. Start MINI. 2. Count cells/givens/pad. 3. Read hints.

Title: Enter correct value
Steps: 1. Select editable cell. 2. Enter its solution digit.
Expected Result: Value is stored; mistakes unchanged; progress updated.

Title: Enter wrong value with autoCheck
Steps: 1. Select editable cell. 2. Enter wrong digit.
Expected Result: Wrong value retained, marked error, mistakes +1.

Title: Add two notes
Steps: 1. Select empty cell. 2. Enable Notes. 3. Press 1 and 2.
Expected Result: Both candidate notes display and persist.

Title: Undo after a move
Steps: 1. Make move. 2. Observe Undo. 3. Activate Undo.
Expected Result: Undo control is visible/enabled and restores state.
Actual Result: Control enabled in DOM but display:none and not visible

Title: Solved board transition
Steps: 1. Set board to solution through debug test helper. 2. Observe modal/save.
Expected Result: Victory modal; active cleared; stats/achievement updated.
Notes: Transition tested; full manual solve not performed

Title: Pause and continue
Steps: 1. Click Pause. 2. Observe modal/focus. 3. Continue.
Expected Result: Board paused; modal focused; resume works.
Actual Result: Modal visible, focus Continue, closed normally

Title: Close pause with Escape
Steps: 1. Press Escape.

Title: Restart persistence
Preconditions: Game with correct and wrong moves
Steps: 1. Save state. 2. Create clean document window with same storage. 3. Continue.
Expected Result: Continue shown and exact board restored.

Title: Setting persistence
Steps: 1. Disable Highlight. 2. Restart document. 3. Open settings.

Title: Arrow navigation
Steps: 1. Focus selected cell. 2. Press ArrowRight.
Expected Result: Selection moves one column with wrap rules.
Actual Result: ARIA label changed to next column

Title: Live feedback exposure
Steps: 1. Trigger status text. 2. Inspect aria-live and computed display.
Expected Result: aria-live region remains in accessibility tree.

Title: Layout 390x844
Steps: 1. Open viewport. 2. Start Mini. 3. Check overflow and board bounds.
Expected Result: No horizontal/vertical document overflow; controls accessible.
Actual Result: No page overflow; board inside viewport
